scripts.build: node -e "const fs=require('fs'); fs.mkdirSync('www',{recursive:true}); ['index.html','style.css','script.js','manifest.json','sw.js'].forEach(f=>{ if(fs.existsSync(f)) fs.copyFileSync(f,'www/'+f); }); console.log('Assets copied to www/');"
scripts.cap:sync: npm run build && npx cap sync android
